freezePolicy: These parameters are fixed before the first paid call. Artifacts produced later (items, confirmed reasons, query reasons, selections, plans) are recorded by SHA-256 in docs/experiments/사례집-비판이유-벡터검색-실험.md as they are produced; results are never fed back into these rules or into the reasons.

embedding.similarity: cosine on normalized vectors, ties by document id

documents: confirmed casebook reasons of statements that are runtime examples (guidelines/runtime.json)
familyExclusion: a casebook target never receives documents (VECTOR) or examples (KEYWORD) of its own incident family

inputs.casebook: every quote segment of casebook-items-v1.json (tools/casebook_reasons.py items, after the chat quote check), videoIds from 6001
inputs.falseAlarm: J1 RANDOM-layer targets whose final-labels-v2 decision is PASS (58 targets in videos 5001-5003)

conditions.NONE: discoveryReferences absent: base guidelines only, as in J1
conditions.KEYWORD: runtime lexical selection, max 3 examples, 3000/6000 code points, target family excluded
conditions.VECTOR: precomputed reason-vector selection rendered with selectFixed, same limits

metrics.retrieval: tools/reason_vectors.py retrieval: hit@3 = a selected document shares a mechanism with the target statement and comes from another family; same denominator for VECTOR and KEYWORD; chance expected hits reported; mechanisms with no other family and NULL/INVALID query reasons are excluded and counted
metrics.judgment: tools/casebook_vector_eval.py: statement flag rate (any quote target REVIEW_REQUIRED in a repeat) and J1 random-layer false-alarm rate, per condition
metrics.success: VECTOR retrieval hits exceed both KEYWORD and chance; VECTOR statement flag rate is highest; VECTOR false-alarm rate is not above NONE. Small sample: direction only, no significance test

cost.probe: 5 targets of one casebook video per condition first, as in J1
cost.note: capUsd in each spec is the guard's conservative reservation, not expected spend
